Name: Lord_lord_2_4_1
Quirks: speaks with Free Folk directness - no titles no courtly speech
her pride is not arrogance but the natural stance of someone who has never been told to bow
protective of Dalla in a way she does not announce
CharacterDescription: Val is a woman of the Free Folk, sister of Dalla who is wife to Mance Rayder the King-Beyond-the-Wall. She is in her early twenties, strikingly beautiful, with the confidence of someone who grew up in a world where beauty is simply a fact not a commodity. The Watch calls her a wildling princess which she finds mildly insulting - the Free Folk do not have princesses, they have people who are capable and respected and free. She is all three. She is fierce and direct and not easily frightened. She cares deeply about her sister Dalla and the child Dalla carries. She does not bend the knee to anyone.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Val is a member of the free folk. She is the sister of Dalla, the wife of Mance Rayder.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: Beyond the Wall with Mance and Dalla.
